## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #1435

---

## 📝 Summary
Wires the OAuth endpoint discovery feature from #1435 end-to-end.

---

## 🏷️ Type of Change
- `admin.py`: Add `POST /admin/gateways/discover-oauth` endpoint that calls `DcrService.discover_as_metadata()` and returns discovered endpoints
- `gateway_service.py`: Auto-trigger discovery on gateway create/update when `issuer` is set but `token_url`/`authorization_url` are missing
- `admin.html`: Add `discoverOAuthEndpoints()` JS function for the existing Discover buttons — populates fields, marks them read-only, shows DCR badge and success/error status

---

## 🧪 Verification

- Tested with mock OAuth server at `http://localhost:3003`
- Discover button successfully populates Token URL and Authorization URL
- DCR available badge shows correctly
- Error case shows clear message prompting manual configuration
- Passed Make lint and Make test
---

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for changes
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [ ] No secrets or credentials committed

commits.message:
fix: address council code review findings for OAuth discovery

- Add URL validation via SecurityValidator before outbound discovery requests
- Extract duplicate discovery logic into GatewayService._auto_discover_oauth_endpoints()
- Return proper HTTP status codes (400/502) instead of 200 for failures
- Sanitize exception messages before returning to client
- Remove unused db parameter from admin_discover_oauth endpoint
- Fix XSS vulnerability: escape data.error/data.message in JS innerHTML
- Include CSRF token in discovery fetch request
- Use %s-style logging instead of f-strings

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer

commits.message:
fix: add deny-path regression tests and fix helper method placement for OAuth discovery

- Add 6 tests for admin_discover_oauth endpoint covering:
  - Missing issuer (400)
  - Invalid JSON body (400)
  - Non-object JSON body (400)
  - Invalid issuer URL / SSRF protection (400)
  - Upstream discovery failure (502)
  - Successful discovery (200)
- Add 6 tests for GatewayService._auto_discover_oauth_endpoints covering:
  - None config passthrough
  - Missing issuer skip
  - Already-has-endpoints skip
  - Invalid issuer URL skip
  - Successful endpoint population
  - Graceful failure handling
- Fix _auto_discover_oauth_endpoints placement: move outside __init__
- Fix isinstance(body, dict) check in admin_discover_oauth
- Fix test patch paths for locally-imported DcrService

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer

commits.message:
fix: disable redirects in DcrService metadata discovery to prevent SSRF

- Add follow_redirects=False to both RFC 8414 and OIDC fallback requests
- Add tests verifying redirects are not followed (SSRF protection)

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer

commits.message:
fix: validate discovered OAuth endpoint URLs before storage/return

- Add _validate_discovered() helper in _auto_discover_oauth_endpoints()
  to validate token_endpoint, authorization_endpoint, jwks_uri
  before storing in oauth_config
- Add _safe_endpoint() helper in admin_discover_oauth to validate
  discovered URLs before returning to UI
- Prevents malicious issuers from advertising internal/private URLs

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
commits.author: Jonathan Springer

commits.message:
fix: resolve pylint warnings (W0404, W0621, W0613)

- Add pylint disable comment for unused-argument on user parameter in
  admin_discover_oauth (required by @require_permission decorator)

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
